title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theater  on 1981-03-05
lineage: DAT > TASCAM DA-20 (S/PDIF out) -> Apogee Wide Eye S/PDIF interconnect -> LynxTWO-A Audio -> (S/PDIF in) -> Wavelab 6.0 (Ozone & L2)
source: NAK 700 (shotgun capsules) > Nak 550 Cassette Recorder > Maxell Metal > HHB Porta-a-DAT

ai_review.summary: A cleaner, lower‑distortion recording showcases a gem of a show, but Brent's electric piano gets lost in the mix.
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that this version sounds a bit cleaner than previous copies, with reduced distortion and crowd noise thanks to slightly lower levels. The performance itself is praised as a "gem" of a show, though the keyboard balance suffers when Brent switches to electric piano. Overall the set is enjoyable despite the mix shortcoming.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlights a good performance and an improved but imperfect recording, leading to an overall rating just above four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cleaner sound with lower levels reduces distortion and crowd noise; however Brent's electric piano is buried in the mix after he switches instruments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Not specifically discussed; reviewer simply calls the show a "gem".

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's electric piano is difficult to hear after he switches, despite overall cleaner mix.
